overview_description.description:
Flowly is a mobile application developed to manage pain and anxiety. Flowly allows users to explore interactive experiences that teach them how to regulate their nervous system through relaxation training. Users can keep track of their progress, and share it all with a supportive community. All content can be experienced on a phone, or in a VR headset that comes with a subscription.

Flowly creates a safe and supportive space where members can share and engage with one another through positive and information-based forums.

product.name: Healing from Pain Program
product.description: A 14-week virtual therapy program combining licensed therapist sessions with neuroscience-based pain and anxiety management techniques.

product.name: Flowly VR System
product.description: A virtual reality and biofeedback system including a VR headset and heart rate sensor for at-home pain and anxiety management sessions.

product.name: Flowly App and Wellness Tools
product.description: A mobile application offering daily lessons, relaxation exercises, and access to support groups to complement pain and anxiety therapy.

product.name: Flowly Providers Program
product.description: A program enabling healthcare providers to integrate Flowly’s VR and biofeedback tools into clinical practice for patient nervous system regulation.

product.name: Open Journey Self-Guided Program
product.description: A self-guided version of Flowly’s program providing access to VR worlds and biofeedback therapy without therapist sessions.
